title.text: Sunrise Balloon Flight with Camel Ride & Breakfast

pills.label: 40–70 min flight
pills.pop_html: In the air: Sunrise launch at the Margham gate of the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve, climbing to around 4,000 ft over dunes and distant mountains. The itinerary blocks 75 minutes for flight and landing; exact air time depends on the wind.

pills.label: Bedouin camp breakfast
pills.pop_html: After landing: Buffet breakfast with coffee, tea, regional food and dessert at a traditional desert camp, about 1.5 hours on the ground before the drive back.

pills.label: Camel + falcon
pills.pop_html: Included extras: A short camel ride at the camp and falconry photos. The full flight video is not in the price: it costs 450 AED.

pills.label: Hotel pickup
pills.pop_html: Transfers: 4x4 pickup and drop-off from any central Dubai hotel, about 50 minutes each way, with Wi-Fi on board. Jebel Ali and Bab Al Shams are outside the pickup area.

best_for.pick_html: for first-timers who want the whole sunrise morning, because €22 more than the flight-only tour buys a camp breakfast, a camel ride and falcon photos on the same 40–70 minute flight.
best_for.skip_html: if you are staying in Jebel Ali or Bab Al Shams (no pickup there) or you only care about the flight and want to save €22.

items.a: Hotel pickup and drop-off, welcome tea or coffee, 40–70 minute sunrise flight, Wi-Fi on board, Bedouin camp breakfast, short camel ride, falconry photos, electronic flight certificate.
Full flight video (450 AED).
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Any hotel in central Dubai, except Jebel Ali and Bab Al Shams.
Children under 5, pregnant women, back or heart problems, over 120 kg, over 80 years.

title.text: Sunrise Hot Air Balloon Tour Over the Desert

pills.label: 40–70 min flight
pills.pop_html: In the air: Sunrise flight at up to 4,000 ft (1,200 m) over dunes and mountains, with a chance to spot camels, Arabian oryx and sand gazelles. Air time depends on the weather.

pills.label: Coffee before launch
pills.pop_html: Pre-flight: About an hour at the base camp for tea, coffee or water and the safety briefing while the balloons inflate. There is no breakfast after landing.

pills.label: 4 hours door to door
pills.pop_html: Timing: About 45 minutes out by 4x4, 1 hour at base camp, 1 hour flying, 50 minutes back. Tied for the shortest full trip on this page.

pills.label: E-certificate
pills.pop_html: Keepsake: Electronic flight certificate included. Pickup covers Dubai's urban areas except Jebel Ali and Bab Al Shams.

best_for.pick_html: for travellers who want the flight itself at the lowest price from a well-reviewed operator, because €249 gets the same 4,000 ft sunrise flight as #1 and you are back at the hotel in about 4 hours.
best_for.skip_html: if you want to eat in the desert after landing: #1 adds a camp breakfast, camel ride and falcon photos for €22 more.

items.a: Pickup and drop-off in Dubai city, welcome tea, coffee or water, 40–70 minute sunrise flight, electronic flight certificate.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Urban Dubai, except Jebel Ali and Bab Al Shams.
Children under 5, pregnant women, back or heart problems, fear of heights, over 120 kg, over 80 years.
English, Arabic, Turkish, Hindi, Urdu, Dutch.

title.text: Luxury Balloon Flight with Breakfast by a Michelin-Starred Chef

pills.label: About 1 hour flight
pills.pop_html: In the air: Sunrise flight at up to 4,000 ft over the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve with an experienced pilot, after a safety briefing at the take-off site.

pills.label: Max 16 per balloon
pills.pop_html: Capacity: Guest numbers are capped at 16 per basket for a more comfortable flight. It runs as a private group, and each Land Rover Defender carries up to 6.

pills.label: Michelin-chef breakfast
pills.pop_html: After landing: A private breakfast inside the grounds of a Royal Nature Reserve, with a menu crafted by a Michelin-starred chef and themed on air, earth, fire and water.

pills.label: Camel ride
pills.pop_html: Also included: A short camel ride around the desert oasis before the drive back. Pickup is from your hotel or private residence, and the guest details UAE rules require are collected before the flight.

best_for.pick_html: for anniversaries, proposals and anyone who hates crowded baskets, because it is the only flight here with a 16-guest cap, private Land Rover transfers and a chef-designed breakfast.
best_for.skip_html: if the flight is the point: the view from 4,000 ft is the same as on the €249 tour, and this costs €169 more.

items.a: Dubai pickup and drop-off, safety briefing, about 1 hour sunrise flight, breakfast by a Michelin-starred chef, short camel ride.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Children under 7, pregnant women, back problems, mobility impairments, wheelchair users.
Up to 16 guests per balloon, up to 6 per Land Rover Defender.

items.q: What should I know before I go?
items.a: Passport or Emirates ID number, nationality, full name, email, mobile and date of birth for every guest.

title.text: Desert Sunrise Hot Air Balloon Ride with Transfers

pills.label: 40–70 min in the air
pills.pop_html: Flight: Sunrise flight over the dunes with a professional pilot, with a chance to spot Arabian oryx and gazelles. Air time is 40–70 minutes depending on the weather.

pills.label: Private group available
pills.pop_html: Who flies with you: You can book it as a private group, and skip-the-queue entry is included. The €284 from-price is the shared seat; the private option is priced separately.

pills.label: Falcon photos
pills.pop_html: After landing: Light refreshments and the chance to take photos with a trained falcon. No breakfast and no camel ride.

pills.label: Insurance + certificate
pills.pop_html: Paperwork: Insurance cover during the ride and a personalised e-certificate. A full flight video by email can be bought on site.

best_for.pick_html: for families or small groups who want their own basket arrangement, because it is the only standard-price flight with a private-group option and it includes ride insurance.
best_for.skip_html: if you are happy to share: #2 has the same flight for €34 less with eight times the reviews.

items.a: Hotel pickup and drop-off within Dubai, safety briefing, sunrise flight, light refreshments, falcon photo opportunity, personalised e-certificate, insurance during the ride.
Full flight video (can be bought on site), tips, other food and drink, transport outside the pickup area.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Children under 5, pregnant women, back or heart problems, fear of heights, recent surgery.
English, Arabic.

title.text: Hot Air Balloon with Camel, Quad & Horse Ride Options

pills.label: 60–90 min listed
pills.pop_html: Flight: Small-group sunrise flight over the Arabian desert and the Hajar Mountains at 2,000–4,000 ft. The longest air time listed on this page.

pills.label: 3 package tiers
pills.pop_html: What each tier adds: Deluxe adds breakfast and a camel ride. Premium adds a quad ride and horse riding on top. The €247 from-price is the base flight.

pills.label: Falcon + pilot photo
pills.pop_html: Every tier: Photo with a falcon, group photo with your pilot, light refreshments, Wi-Fi and a flight certificate.

pills.label: Fast-track entry
pills.pop_html: Logistics: Fast-track entry through a separate entrance and 4x4 pickup from your hotel, about 45 minutes each way.

best_for.pick_html: for groups who want a quad or horse ride after landing, because it is the only balloon trip here with quad biking and horse riding tiers, and it promises the longest air time (60–90 minutes).
best_for.skip_html: if you want breakfast at the base price (it is deluxe tier and up) or you rely on reviews: 4.2 is the second-lowest rating here.

items.a: Pickup and drop-off, light refreshments, licensed pilot, flight, falcon photo, Wi-Fi, flight certificate, group photo with your pilot.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Children under 5, pregnant women, back or heart problems, fear of heights, over 120 kg, recent surgery.

items.a: Breakfast and camel ride.
Quad ride and horse riding.

title.text: Noble Life Sunrise Hot Air Balloon Ride Over Dubai Desert

pills.label: From €234
pills.pop_html: Price: The lowest from-price on this page, €15 below the flight-only tour at #2. Tipping and the flight video are optional extras.

pills.label: 40–70 min flight
pills.pop_html: In the air: Sunrise flight over the desert after watching the balloon inflate and meeting the pilots, with a safety briefing first.

pills.label: Pickup anywhere in Dubai
pills.pop_html: Transfers: Return transport from anywhere in Dubai city, the widest pickup promise of the budget flights. Trip length is about 4 hours.

pills.label: Tea or coffee
pills.pop_html: On arrival: Refreshments at the launch site before take-off. No breakfast, camel or falcon after landing.

best_for.pick_html: for the cheapest seat in a balloon, because €234 includes return transport from anywhere in Dubai city and the same 40–70 minute sunrise flight window.
best_for.skip_html: if you want a proven operator: only 13 reviews and a 4.3 rating, against 480 reviews for #2 at €15 more.

items.a: Return transport from anywhere in Dubai city, 40–70 minute flight, refreshments at the launch site.
Tips, optional flight video.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Children under 5, pregnant women, back or heart problems, over 80 years, recent surgery.
English.

pills.label: Bedouin breakfast
pills.pop_html: After landing: Buffet breakfast at a Bedouin camp, then drop-off back in Dubai. Tea, coffee and water before the flight.

pills.label: Camel + falcon
pills.pop_html: Included extras: A short camel ride and a photo with a falcon. Quad biking and dune bashing are not part of it.

pills.label: 40–70 min flight
pills.pop_html: In the air: Sunrise flight at 2,000–4,000 ft over the dunes, with an electronic flight certificate afterwards.

pills.label: 5 languages

best_for.pick_html: for budget travellers who still want breakfast and a camel ride, because at €246 it is €25 cheaper than #1 for a similar package, and the only one with French-speaking guides.
best_for.skip_html: if reviews matter to you: 3.9 is the lowest rating on the page, and #1 is €25 more at 4.75.
